verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs describe an issue-to-PR pipeline. Automations and Cloud Agents can be triggered from Linear, and the service-accounts docs name "a ticket created in Linear triggering a cloud agent to implement a feature" as a scenario. Agents then build, test and verify changes before pushing a PR, which the API can create automatically (`autoCreatePR`), with artifacts attached and the PR URL reported via webhook. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the issue-to-PR flow works as documented, and explicit evidence of triggering directly from GitHub/GitLab issues (not just PR events, comments or labels).
